notes: Firebird (CFBIRD): no idle fire (the body is orange feathers, not flame), so no boil, no tongues, no steady light. It shares the phoenix's breath and ash art (identical mask px), so its events follow the phoenix spec: DEF-ripped breath with a breath light, a death flare light (DEF death frames 1-2 flash the whole body yellow: roster peak body luma rise 36.7), the burning pillar and the ash pile. Masks are region-segmented (tools/homm3_vfx/phoenix_fire_masks.py): the roster colour rule sees the jet only once it detaches (frames 10-11) because the body shares the fire palette. Both light curves are fitted by the runner (rise over the clip's first key; the death flare peaks on frames 1-2, after key 0, so it is fittable). See docs/homm3_vfx_experiments.md 'Phoenix fire'.
